entries.source:
Gorath halted.
	Blinking slowly, he put a hand over his stomach, then looked towards his confused looking companion...�
entries.translation:
戈拉斯停下腳步。
	他緩緩眨了眨眼，一手按上腹部，接著望向一臉困惑的同伴…�

entries.source: Hold for a moment, Owyn. I wish to speak to you.�
entries.translation: 稍等一下，歐文。我有話想跟你說。�

entries.source: I merely wished to prepare you for things that may transpire before we reach Elvandar. There are ómagics ---things ancient--- which have kept the moredhel from crossing into the forests of the eledhel, but I feel those things have been awakened. I may have some ódifficulty in completing our journey.�
entries.translation: 我只是想讓你先有個心理準備，畢竟在抵達艾爾凡達之前，還會發生些事。有些ó法術——古老之物——一直阻止著莫瑞德人踏入伊列德人的森林，但我感覺到那些東西已經甦醒了。我們這趟旅程，恐怕會遇上一些ó困難。�

entries.source: It was not my intent to alarm you. Only to reassure you that no matter what may happen between here and Elvandar, I have come to consider you a friend.�
entries.translation: 我無意讓你驚慌。我只是想讓你安心——不論從這裡到艾爾凡達之間會發生什麼事，我都已經把你當作朋友了。�
